title: Introduce session-manager and pullstream facade; align retry windows across SDKs
author: Devon Liu
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR introduces two ergonomics-focused primitives in the Python SDK: a lightweight SessionManager that centralizes credential lifecycle and backoff policy configuration, and a PullStreamFacade that provides a pull-based streaming consumer API (sync + async) built on top of the existing event stream machinery. The goal is to give application teams a simpler, explicit surface for session-scoped auth and a safer, lower-friction streaming consumer pattern that matches the developer mental model used in many server frameworks. Additionally this change harmonizes the core retry window/backoff defaults with the recent cross-SDK compatibility doc so Python behavior aligns with TypeScript and Go (reduces surprising reauth timing and transient retry storms).

What changed (high level):
- Add sdk.sessions.SessionManager with context-manager support and explicit refresh hooks; it centralizes token refresh, short-lived session caching, and emits telemetry hooks used by the console.
- Add sdk.streaming.PullStreamFacade: a small facade exposing .pull() (sync) and __aiter__ (async) consuming idioms so clients can write simple for/async for loops without managing low-level state machines. The facade implements graceful reconnect + event dedupe on resume.
- Introduce a shared BackoffConfig object modeled after the cross-SDK spec (initial, max, jitter, reauth-window) and wired into the default client used by session manager.
- Add integration tests for session refresh under race conditions and end-to-end streaming consumer behavior with simulated reconnects.
- Docs: update quickstart and streaming guide with examples for SessionManager and PullStreamFacade.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for SessionManager refresh logic (race and cancellation)
- [x] Integration tests for PullStreamFacade resume/duplicate suppression
- [x] Docs and example app updated
- [x] Cross-SDK backoff defaults validated against ENG-3099 compat matrix

Commits (summary):
- feat(sdk): session manager API + context manager (devonliu)
- feat(streaming): pullstream facade sync+async consumer (devonliu)
- feat(config): import BackoffConfig + wire defaults from cross-sdk spec (devonliu)
- test: add flaky-resume integration harness + deterministic clock (devonliu)
- docs: examples and quickstart snippet (devonliu)

Files changed (high level):
- sdk/sessions.py (new) -- SessionManager, session-scoped client factory, tests\- sdk/streaming/pull_facade.py (new) -- PullStreamFacade implementation and docs examples\- sdk/config/backoff.py (new) -- BackoffConfig and default mapping from compat matrix\- examples/streaming/pull_consumer_example.py (updated) -- example usage\- tests/integration/test_stream_resume.py (new) -- deterministic harness for reconnects\- tests/unit/test_session_manager.py (new) -- race/cancel tests\- docs/streaming.md (updated) -- examples and migration notes\- setup.cfg / packaging metadata (minor)\- sdk/__init__.py (exports)

Review thread (high level):
- Arielle Park: "Auth surface looks reasonable; can we avoid forcing a session object on simple callsites?"
  - Devon: "SessionManager is opt-in; default client factory (client_from_env) remains unchanged. Added example showing direct client usage vs session-scoped usage."
- Miguel Santos: "Tests are good; please add a smoke that runs against the old stream impl to prevent regressions."
  - Devon: "Added a smoke integration that toggles the facade pass-through mode and asserts event parity."
- Jules Carter: "Nit: prefer 'reauth_window_ms' -> 'reauth_window' with Duration object for cross-lang parity."
  - Devon: "Aligned naming and added conversion helpers to keep ergonomic Python types (timedelta) while serializing to numeric when needed."

CI notes:
- Initial CI run failed due to a flaky timing test in test_stream_resume (deterministic clock not wired in one path). Fixed in a follow-up commit; rerun succeeded. Full test matrix green, lint pass.

Compatibility and rollout:
- Default retry/backoff values were changed to match the cross-SDK spec (see ENG-3099). This reduces the default reauth frequency in some edge cases and prevents a known retry spike when short-lived credentials rotate rapidly. The change is backward compatible: existing clients that rely on old numeric values should pin BackoffConfig explicitly. The PR includes a short migration note in docs/streaming.md.

Release notes (user-facing):
- Added SessionManager context API for session-scoped credential lifecycle and telemetry hooks.
- Added PullStreamFacade: a simpler sync + async pull-based streaming consumer for reliable resume and duplicate suppression.
- Aligned Python SDK retry/reauth/backoff defaults with cross-SDK compatibility recommendations (ENG-3099).

Follow-ups planned:
- Create TypeScript/Go reference shims that expose the same PullStream semantics to aid parity across sdks (tracking in ENG-3120).
- Expose a small RFC endpoint on the console that can receive session lifecycle events (telemetry) to power per-session troubleshooting (PM scope).

Notes for maintainers:
- SessionManager exposes a small public interface and a single extension point: register_refresh_hook(callable). Keep that surface stable.
- PullStreamFacade intentionally keeps internal buffer small; if teams need high-throughput streaming they should still use the low-level stream API.
